notes: «أن ابن جريج، أخبرهم» makes Ibn Jurayj a link (rule 5)
«عن أبيه، حسين بن علي» is one link: the name follows the relation with a comma (rule 7), so the surface is the name alone
«قلت لابن شهاب» and «قال ابن شهاب» are scene exchanges; the first occurrence is the link
Ali speaks in the saying («قال علي رضى الله عنه فنظرت») and is the last link
